svg.title: Tech stack
svg.desc: Languages: TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, SQL, HTML5, CSS; Frontend: React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Vite; Backend: Node.js, Express, Django, FastAPI, Socket.io, JWT; Data & queues: MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Redis, Supabase, BullMQ, Redis Streams; AI / ML: Gemini, GPT-4o, RAG · Vector search, Retell AI, PyTorch, TensorFlow, OpenCV, YOLOv5 + DeepSORT; DevOps & QA: Docker, NGINX, AWS S3, Vercel, GitHub Actions, Jest, Playwright, SonarQube, Puppeteer
